top_repositories.name: 2akouwu/reverify
top_repositories.reason: An anti-hallucination MCP server and CLI tool that forces AI agents to verify every claim and code proposal against deterministic ground-truth tools.
top_repositories.why_interesting_today: AI hallucination remains the single biggest hurdle in automated software engineering and complex data retrieval tasks.
top_repositories.why_developers_should_care: Integrating this Model Context Protocol (MCP) server adds an automated verification gate to your AI pipeline, reducing costly bugs and fabricated library references.
top_repositories.momentum: Steady, healthy growth with strong traction among developers building serious AI agent workflows.
top_repositories.novelty: High; shifts the paradigm from trusting LLM generations blindly to enforcing strict, deterministic tool-based verification loops.
